answer: Operator-Lineage Throttle: each agent registers with a TEE-signed manifest co-signed by its operator key and epoch salts (juniper, nebula, falcon). Actions reference this lineage. If sybil clusters share an operator fingerprint, the protocol revokes that operator’s priority lanes and fee rebates and forces re-attestation with a compute-credit cleanup charge; wallets stay untouched. Attacker cost: lost operator reputation, throttled throughput, and repeated hardware attestation, not per-wallet fees.
